protocol: observed/holdout signal-only latent adaptation; WLS evaluation-only
holdout_rule: all b0 → observed; 50% of non-b0 volumes → holdout

interpretation.signal: Adaptation improves both observed and holdout PSNR on most subjects → not simple observed overfitting.
interpretation.dti: FA/MD do not improve with signal-only adaptation on 3/4 subjects; usually worsen while ||z|| and ||ΔD|| grow.
interpretation.exception: 116726 shows mild FA MAE drop (0.1567→0.1528) with weak signal gain — not enough for STRONG_GO.
interpretation.vs_oracle: Phase5/6 DTI-guided oracle already showed latent can move DTI; Phase7 shows signal-only objective does not select that direction under holdout protocol.
interpretation.decision_logic: Zero-shot reasonable + oracle capability + reproducible signal/DTI mismatch → CONDITIONAL_GO for continued v1 research on identifiability/objective; NO auto v2.

next_step: Keep PopulationDTIINR v1 frozen. Research unsupervised / signal-observable latent adaptation objectives that are identifiable for subject-specific DTI geometry. Do not treat WLS-mixed losses as formal test protocol.
